fields.description: First integrity/identity word of the 16-byte EEPROM header (block 0). Stored as-is; no Schema v2 checksum algorithm matched it, so it is a plain field, not a checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 EEPROM block-read primitive (param_1 = 0 reads save-file bytes 0x00..0x07 into RAM dst param_2 via FUN_08044568 DMA handshake on 0x0D000000); block also covered by FUN_0804480c read-back verify. Raw baseline bytes bc ea ea 45 = 0x45EAEABC LE.
fields.name: eeprom_ident_w0

fields.description: Second integrity/identity word of the 16-byte EEPROM header (block 0). Stored as-is; no Schema v2 checksum algorithm matched it, so it is a plain field, not a checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 EEPROM block-read primitive (param_1 = 0 reads save-file bytes 0x00..0x07 into RAM dst param_2 via FUN_08044568 DMA handshake on 0x0D000000); block also covered by FUN_0804480c read-back verify. Raw baseline bytes fe fe d3 7a = 0x7AD3FEFE LE.
fields.name: eeprom_ident_w1

fields.description: Nonzero u16 trailer of the 16-byte header (block 1); only nonzero word besides the ident pair, consistent with a save/update sequence counter.
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 EEPROM block-read primitive (param_1 = 1 reads save-file bytes 0x08..0x0F into RAM dst param_2); writable via FUN_080446ac block-write and checked by FUN_0804480c verify. Baseline 0x4A16 while bytes 0x08..0x0D are zero.
fields.name: save_update_counter

fields.description: Cleared progress bit/cell: 0x00 punched into an otherwise 0xFF-erased progress row (block 32). Flipping bits here is the primary live-mutation probe.
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 block-read (param_1 = 0x20 maps to save-file bytes 0x100..0x107); written by FUN_080446ac block-write and verified by FUN_0804480c. Live libmgba baseline shows 0x00 at 0x105 surrounded by 0xFF erase fill.
fields.name: progress_flag_0x105

fields.description: Cleared progress bit/cell adjacent to 0x105 in the same erased progress row (block 32).
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 block-read (param_1 = 0x20 maps to save-file bytes 0x100..0x107); written by FUN_080446ac block-write and verified by FUN_0804480c. Live libmgba baseline shows 0x00 at 0x106 surrounded by 0xFF erase fill.
fields.name: progress_flag_0x106

fields.description: Cleared progress bit/cell adjacent to 0x105 in the same erased progress row (block 32).
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 block-read (param_1 = 0x20 maps to save-file bytes 0x100..0x107); written by FUN_080446ac block-write and verified by FUN_0804480c. Live libmgba baseline shows 0x00 at 0x107 surrounded by 0xFF erase fill.
fields.name: progress_flag_0x107

fields.description: Isolated cleared progress bit/cell: single 0x00 byte inside 0xFF fill (block 35).
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 block-read (param_1 = 0x23 maps to save-file bytes 0x118..0x11F); written by FUN_080446ac block-write and verified by FUN_0804480c. Live libmgba baseline shows 0x00 at 0x11C surrounded by 0xFF.
fields.name: progress_flag_0x11c

fields.description: Small scalar counter/index (baseline 16) flanked by cleared bytes at the tail of the progress region (block 47); consistent with a stage/level or count value and suitable for live-mutation probing.
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 block-read (param_1 = 0x2F maps to save-file bytes 0x178..0x17F); written by FUN_080446ac block-write and verified by FUN_0804480c. Live libmgba baseline byte at 0x17A is 0x10 while 0x178/0x179/0x17B are 0x00.
fields.name: stage_value

fields.description: Trailing config toggle (baseline 1) at the end of stored data (block 48); suitable for live-mutation probing (e.g. sound/language/difficulty-style on/off option).
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 block-read (param_1 = 0x30 maps to save-file bytes 0x180..0x187); written by FUN_080446ac block-write and verified by FUN_0804480c. Live libmgba baseline byte at 0x183 is 0x01.
fields.name: option_flag_a

fields.description: Trailing config toggle (baseline 1) at the end of stored data (block 48).
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 block-read (param_1 = 0x30 maps to save-file bytes 0x180..0x187); written by FUN_080446ac block-write and verified by FUN_0804480c. Live libmgba baseline byte at 0x184 is 0x01.
fields.name: option_flag_b

fields.description: Trailing config toggle (baseline 1) at the end of stored data (block 48).
fields.evidence: FUN_080445e8 block-read (param_1 = 0x30 maps to save-file bytes 0x180..0x187); written by FUN_080446ac block-write and verified by FUN_0804480c. Live libmgba baseline byte at 0x185 is 0x01.
